key_catalyst: Accelerating rotation out of AI/semiconductor stocks (Micron, AMD, Applied Materials down 7-9%) dragging tech-heavy QQQ
reasoning: The AI/semiconductor rotation that first appeared on 2026-07-28 is accelerating rather than resolving, with Micron (-8.9%), AMD (-8.1%), and Applied Materials (-7.8%) plunging while QQQ is already down 1.12% pre-market, showing the market is not absorbing this catalyst but extending it. With serious news actively developing and multiple binary risks converging into the next session, conviction is strong enough to override the HOLD default.
